page.layout: Left printed page: one column of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin. Right printed page: only a sliver of its left edge is visible at the right of the scan, with the start of its running head and text lines cut off.

main_text.l: sic enim legitur dixisse Dominum, poenitet
me unxisse Saul in Regem, & utiq; potuit
Deus oleum quod dederat auferre, sed cum
voluit docere, non debere contingi oleum e-
tiam in peccatore; ipse qui dederat poeniten-
tiam gessit, igitur Deus, si ut te doceret,
quod dedit, auferre non potuit, per quod
noluit, tu quis es qui auferes quod non
dedisti? & qui parare debebas aures ad audi-
tus, & in duas partes arborum ramis di-
stractus est: Dirae insuper sunt habitae
Quaestiones de complurib9, qui de vita
gos, Aruspices, vel alios: hos Philoso-
utrique testantur, ut crederent in sua situ

page.notes: Right page: only the left edge of its text column is visible, so these fragments are cut off and only partly readable. The lines were copied as far as they show: regr, Imp, care, Ale:, ri p, con, cier, tur, gef, tio, ma, ter, sed, gre, tin, sim, fus, do, du, cr. Their words beyond the scan edge are not printed here. Marginal note letters y, z and a are printed in the left margin. The text mark for z and a are placed in curly braces where they stand. "complurib9" is copied as printed. "vtiq;" was changed to "utiq;" and "nouaculum" to "novaculum" under the u/v rule.
